header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: , it becomes necessary upon every Muslim who hears it to say “Yarhamukallah”. Yawning comes from Shaytan, so if any of you feels a yawn coming, let him hold it back as much as he can. For when any one of you yawns, Shaytan laughs at him.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ اَبِيْ هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهُ ﷺ: مَنْ عَادَ مَرِيْضًا اَوْ زَارَ اَخًا لَهُ فِي اللهِ، نَادَاهُ مُنَادٍ اَنْ طِبْتَ وَطَابَ مَمْشَاكَ وَتَبَوَّاْتَ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ مَنْزِلاً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب باب ماجاء في زيارة الاخوان رقم:٢٠٠٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever goes to visit a sick person, or goes to meet his Muslim brother for the sake of Allah, an angel announces in a loud voice: “You have received barakah, and your walking too is full of barakah. And you have made your dwelling in Jannah!””

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ ﵁ مَوْلَي رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ عَنْ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ عَادَ مَرِيْضًا لَمْ يَزَلْ فِيْ خُرْفَةِ الْجَنَّةِ، قِيْلَ: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! وَمَا خُرْفَةُ الْجَنَّةِ؟ قَالَ: جَنَاهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم باب فضل عيادة المريض رقم:٦٥٥٤
blocks.tamil_translation: When Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever goes to visit a sick person will be in the “khurfah” of Jannah,” it was asked, “O Rasulullah! What is the “khurfah” of Jannah?” The Prophet ﷺ replied, “It is the fruit picked in Jannah.” This hadith is narrated by the freed slave of the Prophet ﷺ,
